Hi

I have a question regarding the timming in which the minion affected
by the /obe/ effect is tapped. Pre block, post block, pre bleed
resolution, post bleed resolution?

Spirit Marionette

/dom/ - Bleed at +1 bleed.
/obe/ - (D) Bleed at +1 bleed, and tap a ready minion controlled by
your prey (even if the target of the bleed is changed).
/OBE/ - +1 stealth action. (D) Take control of any ready untapped
minion until the end of the next action. That minion must bleed your
prey unless he or she must hunt.

(Thanks for answering to everyone :) )
